title: Website Support Automation — Answer, Assign, Follow Up, Never Drop

sections.label: 1 · THE MESSAGE COMES IN
sections.note: One entry point for the web widget or a contact form, so every inquiry gets the same treatment regardless of where it started.

sections.label: 2 · WORK OUT WHAT IT NEEDS
sections.note: Simple, answerable-now questions get answered now. Anything else gets assigned to a person immediately instead of sitting in a queue nobody owns.

sections.label: 3 · INTERNAL COORDINATION
sections.note: The right team member is notified the moment something is assigned, and if it sits too long without a response, they get reminded. Nothing waits on someone remembering to check a queue.

sections.label: 4 · LOG EVERYTHING, FAIL LOUDLY
sections.note: Every inquiry is logged with its outcome, and any step that breaks alerts immediately instead of quietly dropping a customer.
